passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The axolotl is a salamander native to lakes near Mexico City.
• It can regrow lost limbs, parts of its heart, and even parts of its brain.
• Scientists study it to understand tissue regeneration.
• Wild populations have declined sharply because of pollution and habitat loss.
stem: The student wants to contrast the axolotl's value to science with its situation in the wild. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Though scientists prize the axolotl for its ability to regrow limbs and organs, its wild populations have declined sharply.
The axolotl, a salamander native to lakes near Mexico City, can regrow lost limbs and parts of its heart.
Scientists study the axolotl, which can regrow parts of its brain, to understand tissue regeneration.
Pollution and habitat loss have caused the wild populations of the axolotl, a salamander native to lakes near Mexico City, to decline sharply.
steps: A contrast needs both sides: scientific value and decline in the wild.
Only the first choice joins them with “though.”
The others give only one side.
key: Contrast goals need two ideas linked by a contrast word.
